newsitem.title: USA: Host Marriott buys Ritz, sees more purchases.
newsitem.headline: Host Marriott buys Ritz, sees more purchases.

text.p: Host Marriott Corp. said Thursday it acquired The Ritz-Carlton, Marina del Rey, a luxury hotel in Los Angeles, for about $56.6 million.

"This is the fourth Ritz-Carlton hotel we've added to our portfolio," said Terence Golden, president and chief executive. "We intend to acquire more Ritz-Carlton properties and further develop our portfolio of four and five star hotels."
Host Marriott said its latest acquisition is a 306-room hotel in Marina del Rey, near the Los Angeles International Airport. The hotel earned about $6.6 million before taxes in 1996.
The Bethesda, Md.-based company said it has paid $380 million for controlling interests in three hotels this year and expects to end 1997 with over $1 billion in acquisitions.
Host Marriott owns or holds controlling interests in 82 upscale and luxury full-service hotel properties operated primarily under the Marriott and Ritz-Carlton brand names.
Host Marriott's stock fell 25 cents to $16.875 on the New York Stock Exchange at mid-morning.
